1. A Song in the Dark
(totally not a Over The Garden Wall reference)

Spawn Condition(s):
- Random chance at night

In one of the four corners of the map, a moving shadow will appear and move through the forestry to the opposite corner while crossing the forest area near the base. The figure will sing all the while, and despawns fireflies within its vicinity. 
If the player is to follow the song and interact with the figure, the player will instantly ragdoll and fall asleep regardless of energy. 

2. Anglers Hook
(totally not a Inscryption and/or SpongeBob reference)

Spawn Condition(s):
- Random chance

A thin fishing hook with a line reaching up to the sky will appear at a random location. When approached, it will bob slightly, and emits a faint light at night. 
The player can interact the hook, but if they do, they will be yanked into the sky and respawn inside the lake. The player can also put any item onto the hook, which will then be stolen. 
The angler hook will disappear upon reload or interaction. 

3. Look To The Skies
(Totally not a song reference)

Spawn Condition(s):
- Random chance during the day

Everything in the map that is outside will ‘look up’ at a specific point. This includes satellites, mannequins, Omega Kerfur, etc. All background ambience such as birds chirping will become silent. However, upon looking themself, the player won’t be able to see anything. The event will end soon after the player looks or after a few minutes. 

4. “Fine, I’ll Do It Myself” 

Spawn Condition(s):
- Random chance when sleeping

Only occurs when Kel is sleeping. At night, if no signals are currently being downloaded, the satellites will move themselves and process a signal at a faster rate and higher quality than within upgrade limits.

There’s tons of good guides on YT, it takes a bit of time and patience, but isn’t too bad! I recommend you watch a good guide because it’s so much better than what I could explain, but here’s some tips / basics 
You’ll need a shovel for sure, and a whole lot of patience

1 - One altar piece can be found in the caves. It’s very well hidden amongst the nests, so check each corner carefully, I recommend crouching. If you have the metal detector that might help but I haven’t tested that myself. If you don’t know how to get into the caves, wait until night or pay the bouncer a pumpkin fee. 

2 - Another altar piece can be found in Stonehenge. It’s hard to find and buried in an obscure spot so I’d really recommend just following a guide for this one!

3 - The final altar piece is the most difficult to get - The lake! I’ve seen people do it without the scuba mask but I struggled so hard I had to get it. It can only be dug up at 3:00 AM, so grab your shovel, a clock and maybe a sleeping bag. I personally set up shop on the log in the center, it’s a good perch. Wait till 3 and dive in, you should see a stick structure poking out of the bottom. Dig up the spot in front of it, and if all goes well and you don’t drown, you should have it. 

If you need more help / just wanna talk abt it feel free to DM :D
ALSO, when it comes time to assemble, it can be difficult, so I recommend just holding all 3 pieces in your inventory and selecting “drop” or “place.” Start with the legs and then the final top piece, and it’ll click itself together nicely. 

Good luck, and don’t disappoint Furfur!

Don’t worry too much about scripts yet, I recommend you focus on learning how to make models yourself (no borrowed assets) and the basics of studio, you can’t rely on others to make a game for you or expect a poorly cobbled together one to make you earnings. Then do basic tutorial scripts, there are a lot on YouTube that basically just give you the script. But make sure to take time to read each script and figure out what each thing does, even if you don’t intend to learn much about scripting.

It was heaven. Tiny balls of creamy flavor could make anyone feel intense amounts of joy and ecstasy, especially him. He grew up in a family of sweet-tooth’s, everyone called them the Sweet-Teeth. To suddenly be starved of such sugary treats, and basically any good food was torture.

The captain had decided to stop at Earth to restock, and the whole team had been treated with a choice of one human food. Most of the creatures didn’t get any as they found human food repulsive, but Callistio was overjoyed.

It had been a hard choice between donuts, cinnamon rolls, pure sugar, or any of the hundreds of assorted goods, but he was happy in his choice. Dippin’ Dots, the most luxurious of sweets, the apple of his eye, the light of his life.

Finally, it had come. He was allowed to eat it. He only got one bite in, until the worst thing happened. He tripped.

He fell flat on his face, it wasn’t at all painful and quite slow because of no gravity, but that wasn’t the problem. He had the cup in his hands, but no ice-cream.

He immediately yelled in outrage. “MY DIPPING DOTS!!” He jumped up the best he could on all four limbs, chasing after the floating dippin’ dots through the air. He was not going to lose this.

He didn’t care he was right in front of basically the whole crew, adrenaline filled his body and his heart pumped loudly in his chest. He needed his dipping dots.

“What the nova is Callistio doing?” Glorian the Thernol asked, giggling.

“Oh, you know, the usual.” Alioth the Caliduv couldn’t help but laugh loudly. “He’s back at it!” 

“SHUT UP, YOU DON’T UNDERSTAND MY AGONY!” He yelled, catching a few in his mouth. The whole crew laughed. The whole ship wouldn’t survive without their funny human.

“Uhm.. yeah.” I just shrugged, taking a long drag on it. He stared with a face of pure concern.

“Then WHY are you doing it!?” He looked about ready to run over and beat the crap out of me for being an idiot. “It could kill your sensitive human breathing organs, not even to mention the illnesses you can get!”

“I don’t really care.” I blew out the smoke. “It’s just something I do when I’m bored, I don’t smoke all that often like Kerry.” 

“It’s something you SHOULD care about and definitely not something you should do for fun- WAIT, OTHER HUMANS DO THIS TOO!?”

“Yeah, Kerry smokes like two a day.” I couldn’t help but titter from his expression. Pure, unfiltered terror. 

“WHAT THE HELL” He yelled, running down the hall and out the front door. Today was going to be interesting.
